top_html:
Naran Kaghan tour package prices in 2026

Type of trip2026 price (confirm when you book)
3-day group trip from Islamabad or LahoreFrom about Rs 11,500 per person (published)
Honeymoon / couples' packageRs 40,000 (2 days, Shogran) to Rs 60,000 (3 days, Naran) as listed
Guided tours for foreign visitorsOn request
Doing it yourself - jeep to Lake Saif-ul-MalookAbout PKR 5,500 return
Doing it yourself - jeep from Naran to Babusar TopPKR 12,000 return (official fare, July 2026)
HotelsAbout PKR 2,000-4,000 (PTDC Motel, Naran) to PKR 10,000-18,000 (PTDC log huts, Shogran) a night

Prices rise sharply in July and August, when the valley is at its busiest.

Naran Kaghan tours from Islamabad, Lahore and Karachi

  • From Islamabad or Rawalpindi: Naran is 6-9 hours by road, so most tours start here and a 3-day trip works well.
  • From Lahore: most group trips pick up in Lahore as well; Lahore to Islamabad adds about 4-5 hours on the M2, and buses usually get back to Lahore around midnight on the last day.
  • From Faisalabad, Sialkot, Gujranwala or Multan: join a Lahore or Islamabad departure - ask the operator which pick-up points they use.
  • From Karachi: fly to Islamabad and join a trip from there.

Is Naran Kaghan open for tourists?

  • Main season: roughly May-June to October. June and September are the best months; July and August are the most crowded.
  • Babusar Pass: open roughly late May or June to October or November, depending on snow, and only in daylight (gates roughly 7am-6pm).
  • Autumn and winter: from October guesthouses in Naran start to close; the lower valley (Balakot, Kiwai and Shogran) stays open year-round.
  • Monsoon: floods closed Babusar and the Kaghan road for days in late July to mid-August in both 2025 and 2026 - keep a spare day.

For live conditions see my road and pass status page, and the full Naran and Kaghan guide.

day_groups.label: 3-4 days
day_groups.why: Shogran and Siri Paye, Lake Saif-ul-Malook, and Lulusar and Babusar Top - the classic weekend loop.

day_groups.label: 7 days
day_groups.why: The same highlights at an easy pace, with a full day for each excursion.

days_tip: Three days is enough for the highlights from Islamabad. In July and August, add a day - traffic in the valley can triple driving times.

packages.name: 3-Day Shogran, Siri Paye, Naran & Saif-ul-Malook Trip
itinerary: Overnight departure; breakfast in Balakot or Mansehra, then jeeps from Kiwai up to Shogran and the Siri Paye meadows. Night in Shogran.
On to Naran, then by jeep to Lake Saif-ul-Malook; barbecue and bonfire in the evening.
Kiwai waterfall on the way down, lunch in Abbottabad, Islamabad by evening and Lahore around 1am.
good: Lowest published price, all meals listed
watch: Starts and ends with long overnight drives
The same trip is also listed from Rs 12,500 under another name - confirm which price applies
Group trip - ask how many share the vehicle
